headword: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}

definitions.gloss: remote classes; online education; distance learning
definitions.explanation: classes conducted over the internet where students participate from home or other locations

examples.japanese: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}を{受|う}ける。
コロナで{遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Remote classes increased due to COVID.

examples.japanese: {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}では{画面|がめん}をオンにしてください。
examples.english: Please turn on your camera during remote classes.

notes:
MODERN EDUCATION:
{遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう} became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic.

SYNONYMS:
- オンライン{授業|じゅぎょう} - online classes (more common in everyday speech)
- リモート{授業|じゅぎょう} - remote classes

RELATED TERMS:
- {対面授業|たいめんじゅぎょう} - in-person classes
- ハイブリッド{授業|じゅぎょう} - hybrid classes
- オンデマンド{配信|はいしん} - on-demand streaming

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}を{受|う}ける - take remote classes
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}を{行|おこな}う - conduct remote classes
- {遠隔授業|えんかくじゅぎょう}に{切|き}り{替|か}える - switch to remote classes
